title: Internship Opportunity: Materiovigilance Programme of India (MvPI)
bodyHtml:
Take your first step into the world of medical device safety.
Join the MvPI Internship Program and gain practical exposure to materiovigilance, healthcare data assessment, and national public health initiatives.
📍 Apply today and be part of India’s effort toward safer medical device use.
